Verse parallels to the sutta are preserved across several recensions of the *Udānavarga* in the *Bhikṣuvarga* chapter, including Sanskrit versions (UV 32, UVS 32), the Tibetan translation (Uv Kg 32), and Chinese translations in the Taishō canon (T 212.33 and T 213.32).
